newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV files suit against Asturiana de Zinc. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV files suit against Asturiana de Zinc. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: Spain's stock market commission CNMV has filed a suit against Asturiana de Zinc on the basis of evidence it allegedly concealed a speculative position in the zinc market as of 1992, CMNV said on Friday.
The zinc position reached 800,000 (corrects from 80,000) tonnes of zinc, and CNMV added Asturiana had also hidden losses on that position.
Asturiana said in November it had liquidated its loss-making zinc position during 1996, and as a result had been forced to revise downward its forecast for 1996 results.
Asturiana had never disclosed the size of its position which it started to build in 1992, but analysts had estimated it grew to more than one million tonnes during 1993.
By 1315 GMT, Asturiana shares were 85 pesetas down at 1,795.
